children: Crude prices were sharply off highs around 2pm IST as it turned negative and brent breached $96 per barrel.
Brent crude prices had surged towards $97 a barrel in early trade on Monday as US-Iran tensions remained heightened in West Asia.
Brent crude had gained 1%to hit a high of $96.9 a barrel, while the West Texas Intermediate also crossed the $90 mark to trade near $92 a barrel.

The United States said that over the weekend, it launched strikes against three Iranian tankers, destroying one, which sank in the Gulf of Oman. This was in retaliation to Iran's ballistic missiles attack on US' naval warships.

Iran also declared a new restricted zone outside the Strait of Hormuz, as per a top security official, which is set to be officially announcing in the coming days, as per Press TV reports. The restricted zone is set to begin from the US navy blockade line adn extend into areas of the Persian gulf.
Iran too claimed it targeted three tankers. However, there was no independent confirmation regarding the same.

title: Crude oil prices cool off sharply from highs; Here's what you should know
